context: Two teens psych each other up before a mock exam
purpose: Motivate each other; teach 選ば/実力/塾/深夜/起こっ/持た

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 模試の結果で選ばれるクラスが決まる。
lines.en: The mock-exam result decides which class you are placed in.
lines.style: focused teen explaining the stakes, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 実力勝負だね。塾でも特訓してる。
lines.en: It is a contest of ability. I am drilling at cram school too.
lines.style: fired-up teen rising to the challenge

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 深夜まで残って自習してるよ。
lines.en: I stay until late night doing self-study.
lines.style: dedicated teen sharing his routine, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: すごい。何かやる気が起こった？
lines.en: Impressive. Did some motivation spring up?
lines.style: admiring teen probing his drive, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 友達に刺激されて、急に起こったんだ。
lines.en: Inspired by a friend, it suddenly arose.
lines.style: candid teen explaining his spark, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 私も目標を持たないとな。
lines.en: I have to hold a goal too.
lines.style: resolving teen gathering motivation, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 夢を持たせてくれる先生がいるしね。
lines.en: We have a teacher who gives us dreams to hold.
lines.style: grateful teen crediting his mentor, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 上位に選ばれたら一緒に喜ぼう。
lines.en: If we are chosen for the top, let us celebrate together.
lines.style: hopeful teen bonding over the goal

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 実力で勝ち取ろう。深夜の努力は裏切らない。
lines.en: Let us win it on ability. Late-night effort never betrays you.
lines.style: determined teen delivering a rallying line
